title: Urine collection & sample handling
guide: First-morning midstream sample, 2-4 h analysis window with immediate pH, formaldehyde/glutaraldehyde preservation, 2-8°C × 12 h storage, and the avoid-list (72 h strenuous exercise, menstruation, urobag sampling).

title: Physical properties: colour & appearance
guide: The colour table line by line: light yellow normal, pale/white with water loading, pink (desferrioxamine, beetroot), darkening on standing (imipenem + cilastatin), green (triamterene), brown (nitrofurantoin), orange (rifampicin, entacapone).

title: Physical properties: odour table
guide: Every odour-disease pair: pungent (infection/ammonia), musty (PKU), curry/maple syrup (MSUD), sweaty feet (isovaleric acidemia, glutaric aciduria II), cabbage/rancid butter (tyrosinemia 1), cat urine (MCD), acid (MMA), fish (trimethylaminuria), sulfurous (cystinuria), sweet (beta ketothiolase deficiency), swimming pool (hawkinsinuria).

title: Other properties & tubular regulation
guide: Urine vs blood pH/SG/osmolality, CCD alpha-intercalated H+ ATPase acidification with NH4+ (non-titratable) and H2PO4- (titratable) acids, ADH-urea-vasa recta concentration, and the abnormal-value table (type-1 RTA, DI, isosthenuria).

title: High colored urine: causes & dipstick gate
guide: Red/pink/tea/cola urine with the 90/9/1 cause split (carcinoma bladder m/c; intravascular hemolysis), dipstick-negative mimics (porphyria, beetroot) and the 1600 rpm × 5 min centrifugation step.

title: Supernatant flowchart: RBC vs pigment
guide: Clear supernatant → RBCs; glomerular hematuria criteria (≥40% dysmorphic, ≥5% acanthocytes, single RBC cast + proteinuria) → biopsy → IgA nephropathy mechanism; urological arm → USG/CT; standing test separating myoglobin (fades) from hemoglobin (persists).

title: RBC morphology & dipstick parameters
guide: Urological crenated/isomorphic vs nephrological dysmorphic/acanthocytes (Mickey mouse RBCs), leukocyte + nitrite specificity, urobilinogen → extravascular hemolysis, glucose-row euglycemic glycosuria/ketosis, and the leukocyte-dipstick interference list.

title: Proteinuria: uromodulin & protein levels
guide: Tamm-Horsfall protein (70-80 mg/day, TAL origin, cast matrix) and the protein thresholds: <150 normal, 150-500 functional, >500 significant, >300 significant in pregnancy.

title: Albuminuria & tests for proteinuria
guide: Albumin → TGF-β → fibrosis chain, microalbuminuria 30-300 vs albuminuria >300, vascular-integrity significance, and the four tests with dipstick limits (~800 mg threshold, albumin-only detection).

title: Microscopic examination & oval fat bodies
guide: Cell size ladder (RBC < WBC < epithelial), tubular epithelial cell features, phase-contrast monomorphic picture, and oval fat bodies with the Maltese cross list (babesiosis in blood; Fabry's, ADPKD, interstitial nephritis, prerenal azotemia in kidney).

title: Casts: formation & basic types
sec: Casts in Urine - Formation & Basics · p745
guide: Cast formation in the DCT, hyaline (normal + disease) vs granular (kidney disease) casts, woven into the microscopy unit's page order.

title: Casts: specific clinical associations
sec: Casts in Urine - Specific Associations · p746
guide: The full cast table: pigment fine granular (hemolysis/rhabdo), RBC (glomerular hematuria), WBC (pyelonephritis/PSGN/ATN-AIN), muddy brown tubular epithelial (most specific ATN/AIN), broad & waxy (CKD), fatty (lipiduria/Fabry's), eosinophil (ATN/AIN) and fractured (myeloma).

title: Crystals in urine
guide: Every crystal-shape label: uric acid rhomboid, Ca-oxalate dihydrate envelope/bipyramidal, monohydrate dumb bell, Ca-phosphate star (alkaline), struvite coffin lid, cholesterol, amoxicillin broom brush and hexagonal cystine.
